title: Remote viewing a hidden power that pushes for one world government to prepare humanity for space

tellings.quote: the powers that actually are behind the governments and run the governments uh want us to have one world, one government to prepare us for space.

plain: A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan, who practised remote viewing (trying to perceive distant places, people or events with the mind alone), says that hidden powers stand behind the world's governments and actually run them. He says these powers want humanity united under one world government in order to prepare us for space. He tells it as something he came to see through his own remote viewing work, and if true it would mean world politics is being steered toward contact beyond Earth.
